cases.title: Initiate drag event on a valid product item
cases.description: Verify that dragging a product item (draggable='true', data-testid='product-item-1') initiates a drag event and captures the correct title from 'product-title-1' and price from 'product-price-1' for transfer.

cases.title: Drop single product item into drop area
cases.description: Verify that dropping a product item (e.g., product-item-1) into the drop area (id='div1', data-testid='drop-area') successfully adds it to the cart and updates .box1 with quantity, .box2 with product title, and .box3 with unit price.

cases.title: Drop multiple distinct product items into drop area
cases.description: Verify that dropping different product items sequentially into the drop area updates the cart display correctly for all added distinct products.

cases.title: Drop repeated product items to accumulate quantity
cases.description: Verify that dropping the exact same product item multiple times into the drop area properly updates and accumulates the quantity in .box1 while maintaining product details in .box2 and .box3.

cases.title: Drop non-product element into drop area
cases.description: Verify that attempting to drop an invalid or non-product element into the designated drop area does not add any item to the cart or alter the cart display.

cases.title: Calculate and Display Total Price for Multiple Cart Items
cases.description: Verify that the system sums the prices of all products in the cart, formats the total to two decimal places with the appropriate currency symbol (e.g., '$80.00'), and displays it in the div with id 'allMoney'.

cases.title: Display Total Price for Empty Cart
cases.description: Verify that when the cart is empty, the total price displayed in the div with id 'allMoney' is correctly formatted as '$0.00'.

cases.title: Calculate and Display Total Price for Single Cart Item
cases.description: Verify that when a single product is in the cart, its price is correctly formatted to two decimal places with the currency symbol and displayed in the div with id 'allMoney'.

opinions.feedback: The proposed test cases comprehensively cover the requirements for dragging, dropping, handling repeated and distinct items, and calculating the total price with appropriate formatting. No blockers were identified.
All test cases and expected behaviors accurately map to the provided requirements without any blockers.

analysis.analysis: For requirement e2edev_bench_01-R-1: Normal scenario includes dragging a valid product item like 'product-item-1' and verifying that the drag start event captures the title and price from 'product-title-1' and 'product-price-1'. Edge/boundary/abnormal scenarios involve attempting to drag elements without the draggable attribute or missing data attributes. For requirement e2edev_bench_01-R-3: Normal scenarios include dropping single or multiple distinct product items into 'div1' and verifying updates in '.box1', '.box2', and '.box3'. Edge/boundary scenarios involve dropping the same repeated product multiple times to test quantity accumulation. Abnormal scenarios include dropping non-product elements into the drop area. For requirement e2edev_bench_01-R-5: Normal scenarios include calculating the correct sum of multiple cart items formatted to two decimal places with the currency symbol in '<div id="allMoney">'. Edge scenarios include an empty cart displaying '$0.00' or single-item formatting.
